A new mandatory code of conduct for the horticulture wholesale sector was introduced on 14 May 2007 and updated from 1 April 2017. The code is designed to improve clarity and transparency in transactions between growers and wholesalers of fresh fruit and vegetables. For further information about the Horticulture Code of Conduct please visit the Department of Agriculture, Fisheries and Forestry.
